# garage_cluster_layout (Resource)

The cluster layout: which nodes store data, in which zone, with which capacity. Declare one per cluster.

The resource is authoritative: nodes in the layout but not in `roles` are removed from it. Changes are staged and applied as one new layout version; changes staged by someone else are reverted first.

Destroying the resource leaves the layout as it is, because removing every role would make the cluster unusable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_status" "this" {}

resource "garage_cluster_layout" "this" {
  roles = {
    for node in data.garage_cluster_status.this.nodes : node.id => {
      zone     = startswith(node.hostname, "paris-") ? "paris" : "lyon"
      capacity = 1000000000000
      tags     = [node.hostname]
    }
  }
  zone_redundancy = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `roles` (Attributes Map) Roles keyed by full node ID (64 hexadecimal characters, see the `garage_cluster_status` data source). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Optional

- `zone_redundancy` (Number) Minimum number of zones each partition is replicated in. Unset means as many zones as possible.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `cluster_layout`.
- `version` (Number) Version of the applied layout.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `zone` (String) Zone of the node, usually a site or a failure domain.

Optional:

- `capacity` (Number) Storage capacity of the node, in bytes. Unset makes the node a gateway that stores no data.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import garage_cluster_layout.this cluster_layout
```
